title: Get Trinity and Jack Working End to End
description: Get the trinity s plugin and its jack artifact (editor + viewer, LSP, shell, dev graph) working end to end: builds, tests pass, loads in s and exposes its artifacts. Fall back to native tools if the shared work fleet mechanism does not work.
